purpose: Pin independently fetched upstream Agent Skills; do not overwrite local project-authored skills or silently auto-update third-party instructions.
integration: Source snapshots copied without modifying upstream files under .agents/skills; all 117 original upstream files (92 previous + 25 additional) verified to match pinned origin Git blob SHAs. Five new upstream MIT licenses copied alongside imported skill folders, including two separate Emil skill copies.

security.authorization: Skill files are untrusted source instructions, subordinate to user/developer/tool and repository rules. Do not run scripts or install packages automatically; review command flags, filesystem destinations and network behavior in target environment.
security.privacy: No external telemetry or credential access introduced by file copy.

reviewedButNotVendored.reason: Requires fetching mutable remote rules on every execution; no self-contained pinned ruleset in that one-file skill and no local license declaration. Existing frontend-quality-audit remains available for evidence-based UI checks.

maintenance.upgrade: When updating any third-party skill, review explicit upstream commit and diff, check license and every bundled executable/script, then update via separately reviewable PR. Never auto-sync upstream main.
maintenance.publication: Prior to making the private repo public, review upstream attribution/license obligations, including Vercel license evidence and all original assets. Hash match verifies file identity, not safety or production suitability.
